candidates.change_summary: Replace the balance accumulation with an assignment, so repeated Puts overwrite rather than add to the stored balance.
Delete the statement that credits msg.value to the caller's balance, so deposits are never recorded in Acc.
Replace the conditional unlock-time computation with a plain assignment so earlier unlock times are accepted.
Delete the unlock-time update so the holder's unlockTime is never set by Put.
Changed the balance check from `acc.balance>=_am` to `acc.balance>_am`, so withdrawing the exact full balance now reverts.
Changed the time check from `block.timestamp>acc.unlockTime` to `block.timestamp>=acc.unlockTime`, allowing withdrawal at exactly the unlock time.
Deleted the balance decrement `acc.balance = (acc.balance - _am);` so funds can be withdrawn repeatedly without reducing the stored balance.
Changed the logged value from `_am` to `acc.balance - _am` in the AddMessage call, altering the observable log history.
Changed the sent value from `_am` to `acc.balance - _am`, so the user receives a different amount than the logged/deducted amount implies.
Remove the statement that credits the deposited value to the holder's balance, so deposits no longer update Acc[msg.sender].balance.
Replace the balance update with an assignment that overwrites the balance with only the new deposit, discarding any prior balance.
Replace the unlock-time computation with a direct assignment of _unlockTime, allowing callers to set a past unlock time.
Delete the balance-update statement so Collect never decrements acc.balance, allowing repeated withdrawals.
Remove the unlockTime condition from the guard so users can withdraw before the unlock time has passed.
Replace the `revert ();` in the failed-transfer branch with an empty statement so a failed external call silently leaves the balance already decremented without logging.
Delete the statement that credits msg.value to the caller's balance, so deposits no longer update acc.balance.
Replace the balance accumulation with an assignment, so each deposit overwrites rather than adds to the stored balance.
Replace the conditional unlock-time computation with a direct assignment of _unlockTime, allowing lock times in the past.
Insert a duplicate balance-credit statement so each deposit is counted twice.
Delete the statement setting acc.unlockTime, so the lock time is never updated by Put.
Delete the balance deduction statement so the caller's stored balance is never reduced after a withdrawal.
Replace the guard condition with one that omits the unlock-time check, allowing withdrawals before the unlock time.
Delete the LogFile.AddMessage call so successful collections are no longer recorded in the log contract.
Replace the balance update so it adds the withdrawn amount instead of subtracting it.
